basic_info.description: Perched above Glen Park canyon with expansive Southern views & large decks, this mid century two unit building offers light filled rooms & sensible floor plans. 995 Duncan is a 3BR/2BA, 1900 square foot, top floor unit that lives like a single family home. The spacious living & dining area spans the back of the property, opening to a large, South facing deck. There are views spanning from Mt Davidson to South San Francisco. This open & bright space also features a corner, wood burning fireplace. The primary, en suite bedroom has a large walk in closet & its own deck. There are dual pane windows throughout, plus skylights. Kitchen & baths have been updated. 993 Duncan is a spacious 2BR/1BA,1200 sq ft, also with expansive Southern views & its own deck & wood burning fireplace. Both bedrooms are nicely separated from one another.  This 2nd unit provides nice monthly income, or both units could easily be used as a SFR via an internal staircase. The large garage easily accommodates 2 cars, side by side. Enjoy easy access to GP Canyon, the local playground, & the shops & services of the Diamond Heights Shopping Center.
